name: Shard Strike
text:
Jagged metal shards form in the air and lash out from you. You choose shards or spines, which changes the area, damage type, and critical failure effect. Each creature in the area attempts a basic Reflex save save against your class DC.

Shards Shards deal floor((@actor.level -1/2)+1)d6 slashing damage in a 15-foot cone, and a creature that critically fails takes 1d6 bleed damage.

Spines Spines deal floor((@actor.level -1/2)+1)d6 piercing damage in a 30-foot line, and a creature that critically fails is Clumsy 1 until the start of your next turn.

---
Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.
